# sponge — realism QA repair

Yellow foam, green abrasive underside, pinched sides and rounded corners.

## Evidence and numerical review

Three original calibrated frames: f0008, f0269, f0286. Mean silhouette IoU 0.8115. Photo contours are hand traced, with approximately 2–4 px uncertainty at 256 px crop resolution. Explicit masks exclude selected occluders. Wire masks additionally use a dark-pixel threshold. This is not certified segmentation ground truth.

Comparison: [photo / render / overlay](../review/sponge_compare.jpg). Full calibration, masks and measurements: `../review/sponge/`.

Grades: evidence=B, silhouette=B, proportions=B, colour_texture=C, articulation=C, physics=C, collision=B, instances=B

## Changes

- Added three original calibrated photo crops, traced photo masks and numerical comparisons.
- Added explicit mass basis/uncertainty, constituent density, material-specific friction, restitution, COM prior and fragility.
- Added the visible waist indentation and separate foam/abrasive layers.
- Replaced one full box collision with six waist-following sections.
- Added foam translucency and compressible foam material parameters.
- Refined placement and size using three views.

## Remaining

- Exact pore field, dry/wet mass and stiffness are unknown.
- Foam constitutive parameters are tentative; rigid fallback cannot compress.
- Real present mass, friction, restitution and stiffness have not been measured; physics values are explicit priors.
